moes.name: areaUnderWatchFraction
moes.basis: Worst case 0.78, rounded down from 0.782. Twelve drones, 40 min sortie, 20 min swap: 12 x 40/60 = 8 airborne. Transit of up to 4 km each way at 18 m/s is 7.41 min of the 40, leaving 32.59 min of watching per 60 min cycle, so 12 x 32.59/60 = 6.52 drones watch at a time. Each watching drone covers 0.12 of the area (3.0 of 25 km2), more than its 1/12 share, because only the airborne share of the fleet watches; 6.52 x 0.12 = 0.782. Target 0.9 is not met by this arithmetic.

moes.name: coverageUnderMeshJammingFraction
moes.basis: Worst case 0.68. With half the links jammed a hand-over is lost only if the confirmation fails on both of the two nearest neighbours, about 0.5 x 0.5 = a quarter of hand-overs; the leaving member stays until confirmed, so a sector is empty only part of a swap turnaround, about half of it. That cuts the 0.78 baseline by about an eighth, to about 0.68. The dedicated coordination priority class on the mesh radio keeps hand-over messages ahead of relay traffic. Placeholder target 0.75 is not met.
